important_limits: 2019-2022 chose the hyperprior and blend weight, so those scores are not independent evidence
2023-2026 has influenced earlier research and is reused development evidence rather than final promotion proof
posterior intervals omit uncertainty in the separately estimated calibration slope
production forecasts and betting behavior are unchanged
plain_language_conclusion: The preselected blend had a tiny better point estimate, but its uncertainty range includes no improvement. It should not be promoted.
plain_language_method: Five Bayesian logistic prior designs were compared on 2019-2022. The selected design learns separate shrinkage amounts for six feature groups. Its design and blend weight were frozen before 2023-2026.
